construction: 81 parts in 12 steps. Steps 1–4: plates and corner bricks. Step 5: four parrots stand in the arch openings as gargoyles. Step 6: four 1×4×2 arches. Step 9: four hinge 1×2 bases on the cap plate. Step 10: a central `Roof tower pillar` child. Step 11: four identical `Roof tower roof element` children, each rotated about 69° onto a hinge. Step 12: a 2×2 turntable top cap.
interfaces: The parent rotates it 45° about Y onto the corner of the second floor.
lesson: A pitched corner roof from four identical hinged panels around a pillar, with parrots as gargoyles.
parent_context: The corner tower on `10182 - Second floor.ldr` of Café Corner.
reuse_notes: Change the roof by changing the one roof-element child; keep the four copies identical so the hinges close evenly. The hinge angle sets the pitch.
